text:
emma: quick follow-up from today's arch sync. proposing a lightweight 'hand-off gateway' (HG) to avoid per-tenant sidecars. HG negotiates capability + short-lived lease, then either tunnels or proxies streams. dropping a few open questions for feedback.

liam: main ask: how do we keep tenant isolation with a multitenant gateway?

emma: HG is stateless for secrets. it mints ephemeral runtime tokens after validating manifest & policy. all long-term secrets stay in runtime KMS; HG never persists payloads. network policies + runtime enforcement keep isolation.

sofia: manifest impact? private customers can't be forced to change. make it opt-in/optional field under runtime.handoff.

emma: yep. suggested optional snippet: {"runtime":{"handoff":{"mode":"auto","prefer":["hg","direct"],"ttl_s":120}}} keep defaults safe.

harry: perf worry: extra hop. propose two modes: "inspect-proxy" for audits and "fast-tunnel" for low-latency. default to fast-tunnel for streaming.

liam: security: HG->runtime must use mTLS. client->HG uses PoP short-lived tokens. add replay detection telemetry.

sofia: rollout ops: canary by region + tenant opt-in flag. include a global kill switch. private control-planes ignore the handoff block.

emma: failure modes: if HG unavailable, SDKs should try pinned direct runtime when present; hosted non-pinned customers get routed to control-plane fallback or degraded model variant. HG will have circuit-breaker to short-circuit.

harry: teardown: runtime eviction mid-stream is tricky. propose structured eviction frame before close with opaque resume_token signed by runtime. SDK will reconnect and resume if token valid.

liam: dual-write hedging for high-SLA tenants? opt-in only, billed. keeps latency low on takeover but costs more.

sofia: add tests: latency tunnel vs proxy, failover to direct, resume-token replay attempts blocked, privacy audit proving HG stores no payloads. I'll own test harness.

infra-bot: infra task created: https://infra/issue/HG-201  includes mTLS, canary plan, FF gate, cert rotation, dashboards.

emma: will draft concise RFC with sequence diagrams, manifest draft, security model, and canary plan. drop comments here if anything missing. thanks all :rocket:
